WITH latest AS (SELECT id, reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, reporting_period DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en AS product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS confirmed_stock_on_hand, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS confirmed_units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN latest AS l ON f.report_id = l.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en ORDER BY p.sku

SELECT poi.product_name, poi.sku, SUM(poi.line_total) AS purchase_amount, SUM(poi.quantity) AS purchase_cases, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY poi.product_name, poi.sku ORDER BY purchase_amount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.product_name, i.sku, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(i.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY i.product_name, i.sku ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 50

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), rev AS (SELECT f.period_start, f.period_end, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS confirmed_revenue, COUNT(*) AS revenue_fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN periods AS p ON f.period_start = p.period_start AND f.period_end = p.period_end WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY f.period_start, f.period_end), tgt AS (SELECT f.period_start, f.period_end, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS target_revenue, COUNT(*) AS target_fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN periods AS p ON f.period_start = p.period_start AND f.period_end = p.period_end WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.metric_key IN ('revenue_target', 'sales_target', 'target_revenue', 'target', 'sales_goal', 'revenue_goal') GROUP BY f.period_start, f.period_end) SELECT r.period_start, r.period_end, r.confirmed_revenue, r.revenue_fact_count, t.target_revenue, t.target_fact_count, CASE WHEN t.target_revenue > 0 THEN r.confirmed_revenue / t.target_revenue END AS completion_ratio FROM rev AS r LEFT JOIN tgt AS t ON r.period_start = t.period_start AND r.period_end = t.period_end ORDER BY r.period_start DESC
